uv: TEXT ATLAS, not world-scale: map a face onto one cell's rectangle ("cells": u0, v0, u1, v1 with v down), keeping the cell's aspect; 1024 px = 1 m, so a cell's size is the text's real size. Lay the decal face 2-3 mm off the surface; never in Geometry/View/Fire. Text runs top to bottom, columns right to left.
used_on: Carved inscriptions (Koshin, namu amida butsu, directions, donor names, era dates Genroku-Kyoho) as 2 mm proud decal faces
normal_convention: DirectX (green = down), like the library; make_textures.GREEN_DX flips all
render: _ca alpha = coverage; renderFlags NoZWrite (jp_m_wall_grime / vanilla decal pattern). RGB is the material colour everywhere, so the palette mean is meaningful.
note: Inscriptions for steles, Jizo, lanterns, basins, torii and graves; dates Tenna 2 (1682) to Kyoho 12 (1727); no family-name graves (Meiji). The carved look is in the normal map and the shading, not ink. Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1, Yuji Project Authors.
